text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Islamic Action Front boycotts parliamentary elections due to take place next November after majority decision by their consultative council heeds earlier call by Moslem Brotherhood.
- Parliamentary Speaker Saed Srour says royal decree passed this week telling government to hold elections is proof of desire by Jordan's leadership to expand democracy.
- Ship carrying Thai rice bound for Iraq discharges cargo at Jordan's Red Sea port of Aqaba.

- Prime Minister Majali heads to Oman for two-day visit to meet Omani officials and deliver message from King Hussein to Omani Sultan Qaboos; Majali leaves on Saturday for Malaysia to attend international economic conference.
